description:
The return-group cut needs a complete call-edge authority, not the broader fz-kdt.98.2 Reaches experiment. `static_edges` emits `StaticEdge::Lambda` for `LoweredStep::Lambda` but omits `LoweredStep::FunctionRef`, though both mint a callable value naming a function. Fold the two into one construction edge. Witness: `call/2` applying `&pong/1` and `&ping/1` is three singleton components today; after, ping and pong share one component and `Recursive` is true for both. A function reference closes over nothing, so it must not consume callable identity.

This is the body-edge half of fz-kdt.98.3. Keep the existing `StaticCallees → DeriveCallGraphComponent` path for this cut; do not introduce `Reaches(f)` or alter transport reachability here. TDD: the witness is recursive on both doors, equivalent replays are quiet, corpus canon/artifacts remain identical, and causal counts on json_roundtrip are recorded rather than traded for an unrelated architecture rewrite. Second commit of fz-kdt.98.
title: A function reference is a construction edge of the call graph, as a lambda already is
